correctness.rationale: The included independent-from-prior-package script reconstructs the 30-vertex symplectic incidence graph, all 30 ten-vertex neighborhood facets, and every one of its 27,535 nonempty faces; it constructs 13,695 disjoint matched Hasse incidences and topologically sorts all 144,210 oriented Hasse edges, certifying acyclicity. Exactly one critical 0-cell and 144 critical 2-cells remain, hence Forman CW reduction gives an integral wedge of 144 \(S^2\). The complex is pure dimension nine so non-shellability follows. Independent exact mod-two boundary ranks 29,406,2070 and Euler characteristic 145 corroborate the computation, not replace the homotopy proof. Exact scope is a 30-vertex finite complex; no infinite claims.

value.rationale: The unique (3,8)-cage and smallest thick generalized-quadrangle incidence graph are canonical highly symmetric topological test objects. The first scale beyond the general girth-recovery bound \(r<4\) has no prior graph-recovery guarantee; determining an exact wedge of 144 \(S^2\), integral torsion-freeness, and non-shellability is a meaningful motivated finite cutoff. The result is not just a normalization check, face table, or cosmetic parameter change; a complete acyclic matching resolves the homotopy type.
